apis.Name: /v1/integration/reference-master
apis.Purpose: ERP inbound snapshot of cost centres, projects, departments and active GL accounts (FULL or DELTA per master type)
apis.Note: Idempotent on snapshot_id and per row on master_type + code + payload_hash; a FULL snapshot deactivating more than 10% of active codes is held for Finance confirmation; codes are end-dated, never hard-deleted

apis.Name: /v1/integration/vendor-master
apis.Purpose: ERP inbound snapshot of contractor and vendor codes, contract terms, statutory registrations and rate cards
apis.Note: Idempotent on snapshot_id and per row on vendor_code + payload_hash; ERP-owned vendor fields are read-only in Nucleus; a Blocked vendor stops new deployments and flags open invoices

apis.Name: /v1/attendance/devices/{device_id}/heartbeat
apis.Purpose: Site agent or terminal liveness signal with buffer depth and clock offset for the device health report
apis.Note: Expected every 5 minutes; mTLS with the agent enrolment certificate bound to its location grant; a device silent for more than 15 minutes in a rostered shift raises a device-failure exception (RL-140)

apis.Name: /v1/channels/messaging/inbound
apis.Purpose: Inbound user messages, button replies and shared locations from the business messaging channel
apis.Permission: Provider HMAC-SHA256 signature plus source allow-list (no bearer scope); actions run under the bound person's own permissions
apis.Note: Idempotent on the provider message_id; action tokens are signed, single use and expire after 24 hours; every action calls the same domain service and rules as the app; unbound numbers receive the onboarding reply only

apis.Name: /v1/integration/bgv/callback
apis.Purpose: Background-verification case status, per-check results and report availability for the pre-boarding chain
apis.Note: Deduplicated on the provider event_id; a callback for an unknown case_ref is rejected and alerted; a DISCREPANT or UNABLE_TO_VERIFY result opens a human review task and never rejects the candidate

apis.Name: /v1/integration/esign/callback
apis.Purpose: E-signature envelope status, signed document and audit certificate
apis.Note: Deduplicated on the provider event ID; a signed file whose hash chain does not match document_sha256 is rejected and alerted; DECLINED and EXPIRED return the letter to HR

apis.Name: /scim/v2/Users
apis.Purpose: SCIM 2.0 service endpoint for directory-driven provisioning of principal accounts (provisioning mode B)
apis.Note: Creates principal accounts awaiting linkage only, never person, employment or assignment records; keyed on externalId = employee code; a 409 on userName is held for the administrator

apis.Name: /scim/v2/Groups
apis.Purpose: SCIM 2.0 service endpoint exposing the tenant-configured role groups to the enterprise directory
apis.Note: Group membership derives from Nucleus role, entity and location grants; no SCIM attribute maps to an entity or location grant (PLT-INT-004.04)

apis.Name: MCP server (initialize, tools/list, tools/call)
apis.Purpose: Expose the twelve governed tools of IA-01 to the client AI environment under the same policy gate, autonomy limits and action ledger as internal agents
apis.Permission: OAuth 2.1 authorisation code with PKCE bound to a human principal; tool scopes equal the IA-01 permissions
apis.Note: Side effect per tool as in IA-01; dry_run on tools marked dry run; every tools/call creates an action ledger row; disbursement, termination, offer release, statutory filing and loan sanction are at most proposed; default 60 calls per minute per principal

events.Consumers: Sync monitor (SCR-101), duplicate check FIN-01.4, sync reconciliation
Payroll run approval gate (SCR-050), GL mapping screen (SCR-102), Finance notifications

events.Payload (beyond envelope): journal_id, run_id, mechanism, target_system, attempt_no, result(posted|rejected|pending), external_doc_no
events.Consumers: Posting log (RP-15), payroll run write-back FIN-03.5, Finance alerts, reconciliation
Reconciliation screen (SCR-103), Finance, payroll period close, analytics

objects.Fields: verified_domains[], provisioning_mode(worker_driven|directory_driven), step_up_acr
objects.Notes: Sign-in email must fall in a verified domain; provisioning mode A (Nucleus to directory) is the default; step-up context gates payroll approval, bank release and salary view.

objects.Fields: idp_subject_id, identity_provider, scim_external_id, link_status(linked|awaiting_linkage), account_source(federated|scim|local)
objects.Notes: A subject identifier links to exactly one principal; SCIM creates in mode B wait for linkage; no password is stored for federated tenants.

objects.Fields: pt_registration_no, lwf_registration_no
objects.Notes: Registration carried on professional-tax and labour-welfare returns; the form set follows the plant's registration (RL-380).

objects.Fields: idempotency_key
objects.Notes: Caller key for write tools over MCP; a repeat from the same principal within 24 hours returns the original result and action_id.

objects.Fields: log_id, message_id, tenant_id, interface_id, direction, counterparty, business_key, payload_hash, size_bytes, outcome, latency_ms, retry_count, occurred_at
objects.Notes: One row per exchange on every interface; Personal and Restricted payload bodies are never written, only hashes and business keys (PLT-INT-108).

objects.Fields: idempotency_key, client_id, principal_id, endpoint, request_hash, first_response, created_at, expires_at
objects.Notes: Kept 24 hours; a repeat returns the first response unchanged (PLT-INT-103).

objects.Fields: entry_id, interface_id, message_id, business_key, attempts, last_error, dead_lettered_at, incident_ref, replay_status, replayed_at
objects.Notes: Created after the sixth failed attempt; visible on the owning monitor screen with a replay action (PLT-INT-105).

objects.Fields: credential_ref, counterparty, interface_id, environment, credential_type(oauth_client|mtls_certificate|hmac_secret|sftp_key|openpgp_key), vault_path, rotated_at, expires_at, next_rotation_due
objects.Notes: Metadata only; the secret itself lives in the tenant secrets vault and never in configuration, logs, events or LLM prompts; distinct per environment (PLT-INT-111).

objects.Fields: subscription_id, client_id, endpoint_url, event_types[], scope(entity, location), secret_ref, mtls_enabled, status(active|paused), failing_since, created_by
objects.Notes: Scoped no wider than the subscribing client's grants; paused after 72 hours of continuous failure and the owner notified.

objects.Fields: delivery_id, subscription_id, event_id, nucleus_idempotency_key, attempt_no, http_status, latency_ms, outcome(delivered|retried|dead_lettered), attempted_at
objects.Notes: Inspectable and replayable by event id within the event's retention class (PLT-INT-002.04).

objects.Fields: operation_id, external_id, assignment_id, version, operation(create|update|deactivate), target, status, attempts, last_error, completed_at
objects.Notes: Keyed on assignment_id + version so replays reach the same end state; a leaver deactivation still failing after attempt 3 raises a security incident.

objects.Fields: interface_id, batch_ref, drill_ref
objects.Notes: Every interface writes its reconciliation here; universal assertion received = applied + held + rejected + duplicate (PLT-INT-106).

objects.Fields: erp_employee_key, official_email, preferred_language
objects.Notes: erp_employee_key holds the ERP key (for example VPI-1018) so the mapping survives a code change on either side; official_email feeds the SCIM userName and the sign-in email claim; preferred_language selects the message template language.

objects.Fields: bank_account_token, bank_ifsc, bank_account_holder_name, bank_verification_status, bank_verified_by, bank_verified_on
objects.Notes: Account number detokenised only inside the bank file builder; a change inside a payroll window raises an alert (RL-393); unverified accounts are excluded from the bank file.

objects.Fields: pf_membership_date, eps_eligible, vpf_rate_pct, esi_coverage_status, esi_coverage_period
objects.Notes: Carried at migration so PF and ESI files continue correctly; coverage is re-evaluated when cut-over opens a new ESI contribution period.

objects.Fields: continuous_service_start, recognised_prior_service_months, prior_service_basis
objects.Notes: Gratuity eligibility and the 6x loan ceiling compute from these facts (PLT-MIG-035).

objects.Fields: category_code, sub_category_code, label, worker_class_code
objects.Notes: Worker class resolves from category, sub-category and employee-level overrides, never from a legacy grade string (PLT-MIG-014).

objects.Fields: device_event_id, agent_batch_id, punch_ts_device, verification_mode(FINGER|FACE|CARD|PIN), offline_queued, signed_ts
objects.Notes: Raw device timestamp kept beside the corrected punch_ts; offline events need a signed timestamp and are accepted up to 7 days old (RL-071).

objects.Fields: device_id, location_id, agent_id, device_type(BIOMETRIC|ACCESS_CONTROL|KIOSK), status, last_heartbeat_at, buffer_depth, clock_offset_ms
objects.Notes: Registered terminal at the agent's location; feeds the per-shift device health report.

objects.Fields: agent_id, location_id, client_id, certificate_ref, certificate_expires_on, software_version, schema_version, status
objects.Notes: Enrolled with a per-agent certificate and bound to a location grant; signs each batch.

objects.Fields: device_id, enrolment_no, person_id, effective_from, effective_to
objects.Notes: Resolves a terminal enrolment number to exactly one active person; biometric templates are never transmitted or stored.

objects.Fields: quarantine_id, agent_batch_id, device_id, device_event_id, enrolment_no, punch_ts_device, reason(unknown_device|unknown_enrolment), exception_id, resolved_by, resolved_at
objects.Notes: Unresolvable punches are landed here and raise an exception on SCR-025, never discarded.

objects.Fields: person_id, leave_type, policy_code, months_accrued, eligibility_wait_served_months, completion_credit_due, as_of_date
objects.Notes: Migrated so the first Nucleus accrual and any completion credit are neither lost nor duplicated (PLT-MIG-032).

objects.Fields: migrated
objects.Notes: Year-to-date history loads as closed historic runs flagged migrated and is never recomputed.

objects.Fields: legal_entity_code, value_date, mechanism(host_to_host|file), file_kind(run|re_payment), original_file_ref, status(generated|released|verified|transmitted|cancelled)
objects.Notes: One file per run and entity unless the first is formally cancelled with the bank; returned lines are re-paid in a separate file.

objects.Fields: obligation_id, layout_version, revision_no, revision_reason
objects.Notes: A repeat generation for a filed period creates revision n+1 with a reason; the layout in force for the period is selected from the rule pack.

objects.Fields: person_id, financial_year, regime(OLD|NEW), declaration_status, proof_status
objects.Notes: Regime is carried on the TDS statement deductee record; migrated with year-to-date tax.

objects.Fields: person_id, financial_year, previous_employer_name, taxable_income, tds_deducted, proof_ref
objects.Notes: Joiners in the year; needed for the TDS projection and annual tax statement (PLT-MIG-034).

objects.Fields: form_code, location_id, last_serial_no, as_of_date, source(migrated|generated)
objects.Notes: Keeps gapless registers such as Form F continuous across cut-over (PLT-MIG-009).

objects.Fields: master_mode(nucleus_owns|erp_owns|co_owned), erp_system, sync_frequency, match_key, unmatched_action, primary_mechanism, fallback_mechanisms[], connector_ref
objects.Notes: Per tenant; source_system on an inbound batch must equal erp_system; every tenant has a primary and at least one fallback journal delivery mechanism.

objects.Fields: legal_entity_code, department_code, org_unit_code, effective_from, maintained_by
objects.Notes: Maps ERP departments to Nucleus org units; an unmapped department on an inbound record is held.

objects.Fields: master_type(COST_CENTRE|PROJECT|DEPARTMENT|GL_ACCOUNT), code, name, status(Active|Inactive|Blocked), parent_code, level, legal_entity_code, account_type, valid_from, valid_to
objects.Notes: Read-only reference store; deactivation is effective-dated so historic journals stay valid; unknown or inactive codes raise HIGH pre-audit flags and an unknown account blocks journal generation.

objects.Fields: snapshot_id, master_type, snapshot_mode(FULL|DELTA), code, payload_hash, received_at, applied_at, status(applied|applied_no_change|rejected|held), error
objects.Notes: Reference sync report: received = applied + no change + rejected + held.

objects.Fields: journal_version, idempotency_key
objects.Notes: Key {tenant_id}:{run_id}:{legal_entity_code}:{journal_version} travels in the ERP reference field; a posted journal is immutable.

objects.Fields: posting_id, journal_id, run_id, idempotency_key, mechanism(api|xml_voucher|csv|staging_table|manual_download), target_system, attempt_no, sent_at, result(posted|rejected|pending|dead_lettered), external_doc_no, error
objects.Notes: Records what was sent, when, where, with what result and what reference came back, whatever the mechanism (RL-523); source of RP-15.

objects.Fields: payment_ref, file_ref, seq_no, person_id, amount, status(ACCEPTED|PROCESSED|REJECTED|RETURNED), bank_txn_ref, reason_code, status_at, repaid_by_payment_ref
objects.Notes: Rejected or returned lines form the returned-payment queue and are re-paid only through a separate file; account numbers never stored here.

objects.Fields: bank_code, layout_version, format(fixed_width|csv|credit_transfer_xml), effective_from, test_file_ref, approved_by_bank_on
objects.Notes: Switching layout is configuration with a test file approved by the bank.

objects.Fields: message_id, direction(inbound|outbound), person_id, template_code, language, category(transactional|announcement), idempotency_key, context_message_id, source_event_id, status(sent|delivered|read|failed), occurred_at
objects.Notes: Outbound key source_event_id + recipient + template_code; free text purged after 30 days; source of the message delivery log.

objects.Fields: binding_id, person_id, mobile, verified_at, consent_id, status(bound|withdrawn)
objects.Notes: A number is bound to exactly one person by one-time code before any personal data is sent; messages stop within 1 hour of withdrawal.

objects.Fields: token_id, approval_step_ref, action, person_id, issued_at, expires_at, used_at
objects.Notes: Signed and single use with 24-hour expiry, so a double tap approves once.

objects.Fields: template_code, language, version, category, parameters[], approval_status
objects.Notes: Approved per tenant and language; parameters never carry Aadhaar, PAN, account numbers or salary figures.

objects.Fields: case_ref, candidate_id, offer_id, check_set_version, consent_id, provider_case_id, case_status(INITIATED|IN_PROGRESS|INSUFFICIENT|CLEAR|DISCREPANT|UNABLE_TO_VERIFY), check_results[], report_document_id, requested_at, decision, decided_by, decision_reason
objects.Notes: case_ref = candidate_id + offer_id + check_set_version; results are provider-owned and read-only; the hiring decision is human with its reason.

objects.Fields: check_set_version, applies_to, checks[](IDENTITY|ADDRESS|EDUCATION|EMPLOYMENT|CRIMINAL_RECORD|REFERENCE), turnaround_days
objects.Notes: Tenant check set per position; the version is recorded on each case.

objects.Fields: envelope_ref, issue_id, revision, template_id, template_version, document_sha256, signers[], signature_method(OTP_ESIGN|AADHAAR_ESIGN|DSC), expires_at, status(SENT|VIEWED|SIGNED|DECLINED|EXPIRED|COMPLETED), signed_file_ref, audit_certificate_ref, completed_at
objects.Notes: envelope_ref = issue_id + revision; signed artefact kept with the template version; becomes Restricted when the letter carries compensation.

objects.Fields: legal_entity_id, person_id, document_types[], allowed_signature_methods[], effective_from, effective_to
objects.Notes: Only methods approved for the document type are offered (EXP-INT-001.04).

objects.Fields: revision, signature_status
objects.Notes: A re-issue after DECLINED or EXPIRED creates a new revision.

objects.Fields: vendor_code, vendor_name, status(Active|Inactive|Blocked), engagement_type, clra_licence, pf_code, esi_code, gstin, sites_served[], statutory_verification_status
objects.Notes: Reconciles to the client's vendor master by vendor_code; ERP-owned fields are read-only in Nucleus.

objects.Fields: engagement_type
objects.Notes: Picklist value received on the vendor master interface.

objects.Fields: legacy_key, migration_batch_id
objects.Notes: Column set carried on every record loaded with treatment M, H or O so each reconciliation query traces back to source (PLT-MIG-004).

objects.Fields: migration_batch_id, tenant_id, rehearsal(mock_1|mock_2|mock_3|cut_over), wave(W0..W8), extract_ref, extract_signature_verified, cross_reference_version, started_at, completed_at, records_extracted, records_loaded, records_rejected, records_excluded, wave_check_status, status
objects.Notes: A wave is refused until its predecessors pass their wave checks (PLT-MIG-015, PLT-MIG-016).

objects.Fields: migration_batch_id, level(L1|L2|L3|L4|L5), object, scope(entity, location, worker_class, payroll_group), check, expected, actual, variance, tolerance, status, drill_ref
objects.Notes: Persisted as reconciliation_report rows of the migration batch and shown on the migration reconciliation screen with drill-down; amounts masked unless the viewer may see compensation.

objects.Fields: xref_type(employee_key|department|grade|employment_type|leave_code|pay_head|location_payroll_group|shift), legacy_value, nucleus_value, version, used_in_mock, approved_by
objects.Notes: Versioned and applied by the load service, never by editing extracts (PLT-MIG-012).

objects.Fields: target_object, target_field, source_system, source_field, extraction_filter, rule(direct|lookup|transform|default|derived), mandatory, owner(ERP|Nucleus), validation, sample_evidence, signed_by
objects.Notes: One specification per target object under configuration management; zero unmapped mandatory fields before Mock 2 (PLT-MIG-011).

objects.Fields: object, treatment(M|H|O|C|D|N), history_depth, demo_dataset_ref, legacy_source, data_owner_role, signed_by
objects.Notes: Covers every DA-01 object before Mock 1 (PLT-MIG-007).

objects.Fields: error_id, migration_batch_id, object, legacy_key, field, rule_id, reason, status, resolved_by
objects.Notes: Error queue; Restricted values appear only as tokens or masked (PLT-MIG-020).

objects.Fields: correction_id, object, legacy_key, field, legacy_value_masked, corrected_value_masked, reason, approved_by, approved_at
objects.Notes: Cleansing is never done silently in an extract (PLT-MIG-028).

objects.Fields: defect_id, mock, classification(extract|mapping|transformation|product|legacy_data), severity, object, owner, status
objects.Notes: No open blocking defect at any mock exit (PLT-MIG-043).

objects.Fields: migration_batch_id, dimension(completeness|validity|accuracy|uniqueness|consistency|integrity|timeliness), object_scope, threshold, measured_value, blocking, status
objects.Notes: Measured on every mock and trended; a blocking breach stops cut-over (PLT-MIG-051, PLT-MIG-052).

objects.Fields: cycle_period, person_id, component_code, legacy_amount, nucleus_amount, variance, classification(legacy_defect|nucleus_defect|agreed_rule_difference), resolved_by, signed_off_by
objects.Notes: Final cycle must show zero unexplained variance to the paisa (PLT-MIG-038).

objects.Fields: item_id, legacy_key, change_type(joiner|leaver|change), captured_on, captured_by, applied_on, status
objects.Notes: Applied in Nucleus within one working day of go-live (PLT-MIG-046).

objects.Fields: data_set, legacy_system, archived_on, retention_until, custodian, access_roles[]
objects.Notes: Legacy audit trails, GL history and bank-file history are archived read-only, never migrated as live data (PLT-MIG-010).
